title: The KYC Update
intro: A text says your Ostrel account needs "identity re-verification" under a new rule.
Real exchanges do check identity, so this might be true. Or it might be a trap.

screen.context: You verified your identity on Ostrel when you signed up, months ago.

link.label: Look-alike link
link.why: Identity checks happen inside the app, never through a text link.

docs.label: Asks for ID and selfie
docs.lens: A photo of your ID and your face lets thieves open accounts in your name.
docs.why: These are the hardest things to change if stolen.

threat.label: Funds frozen
threat.why: Pressure stops you from checking in the app.

timer.label: 48 hours
timer.why: Real compliance notices give time and appear in the app.

rule.label: Vague "new regulation"
rule.lens: It names no rule and no date.
rule.why: Vague official-sounding reasons fit everyone, so scammers use them.

sender.label: Ostrel Compliance
sender.why: Anyone can type a sender name.

actions.label: Open the Ostrel app and look for any verification request
Delete it and report the text as junk

trap.title: Ostrel · Identity check
trap.ask: Upload a photo of your ID and a selfie to keep your account.

block_report.line: Reported and deleted. The fake site was taken down.

verify.line: The app showed no request at all. The text was fake. Case cracked.
verify.mirageSays: Hmph. They opened the real app.

ignore.line: You ignored it safely. Reporting protects others.

go_ahead.line: Your ID and selfie were used to open accounts in your name, and your login was copied too.

what_if.go_ahead: The real app showed no request. Checking there first would have saved your ID.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting the text helps others.
what_if.ignore: Ignoring it was safe. A quick report protects others.

golden_rule: Identity checks happen inside your exchange app. Never upload ID through a link in a text.

quick_check.q: A text says to re-verify your identity within 48 hours or lose access, through a link. What do you do?

options.text: Upload quickly, ID checks are real
Do not click. Open the app and report the text
Upload only your ID, not the selfie
Reply to ask if it is real

quick_check.explain: Real checks live in the app. A link, a deadline and a threat are the signs.

hints.nudge: Where should an identity check happen?

rows.k: A deadline with a frozen-funds threat
